subject: Joint delivery plan & launch readiness — consolidated next steps and sign-off
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novumhealth.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + proposed joint delivery plan (post-demo)

Hi Sarah / Ben —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Mobile demo looked great and the team had a lot of useful questions. Per our ask to capture next steps, I pulled together a short draft of the joint delivery plan (JDP) with milestones, owners, and dependencies so we have one living artifact to move to signature.

High-level recap from the call:
- Goal: embed Redwood inference for clinical summarization in Novum’s triage workflow (POC -> pilot -> production).
- Target go-live window: mid-Jan (you mentioned Jan 15–22 during the call).
- Critical dependencies: procurement PO, network peering, test dataset access, SOC 2 evidence for legal review.

Next steps (short):
1) We’ll circulate a draft JDP with milestone dates and responsible parties (attached).
2) You’ll confirm procurement timing and whether a PO will be in place before Dec 20.
3) Rishi will schedule a technical onboarding session for your infra team next week.

I attached an initial draft (20261203_Novum_Joint-Delivery-Plan_v1.pdf) — it’s a working doc, please flag anything that’s off. If the dates look plausible I’ll ask Legal and Procurement to prepare the signature packet (DocuSign) once you confirm.

Thanks — appreciate the momentum.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20261203_Novum_Joint-Delivery-Plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 4 pages)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novumhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@novumhealth.com>, Novum Health Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed joint delivery plan (post-demo)

Sean — thanks for the recap and for pulling that together so quickly. Quick notes after a read-through: 

- Dates: Jan 15 go-live is our preference but procurement warned that a PO in hand by Dec 20 is optimistic. We can confirm by EOD Friday (Dec 4).
- Dependencies: Please add an explicit line for our security questionnaire turnaround (we aim to return it within 3 business days after you send the evidence bundle).
- Milestones: Add a customer-facing success criteria row under Pilot -> Production (KPIs: summary accuracy >= 88%, latency p95 < 450ms).

We’ll share internal redlines from Procurement (Ben copied). For now the project sponsor (Dr. Maya Patel) asked that we aim for a final executable by Dec 22 so validation can start in early Jan.

If you can incorporate the three changes and send the version to Legal/Procurement and me for sign-off, I’ll prioritize internal review.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Director, Product Integration | Novum Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed joint delivery plan (post-demo) — tech onboarding & evidence bundle

Folks — looping in for the technical pieces. Action items for Redwood: 
- I will own the onboarding session (propose Thurs 12/9 at 11AM PST).
- Monica: can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts we can include in the evidence bundle (we typically share SOC2 Type II summary, relevant policies, and our pen-test report abstract).
- Sean: once Sarah confirms the pilot success KPIs we’ll add test datasets and evaluation plan to the JDP.

Monica — if we’re okay with sharing the standard SOC2 packet and a short architecture diagram, I’ll package and post to the Drive link and ping Sarah.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novumhealth.com>, Novum Health Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated Joint Delivery Plan (v1.1) + redlines incorporated — ready for sign-off

Hi Sarah / Ben —

Thanks for the quick feedback. Attached is the updated JDP (20261206_Joint-Delivery-Plan_v1_redlines.pdf) incorporating: 
- Confirmed pilot -> prod KPIs (accuracy and latency rows added).
- Security turnaround expectation and deliverable list.
- Milestone dates shifted slightly to reflect procurement constraints (final exec signature target: Dec 22).

What we need from Novum to move to signature:
1) Procurement confirmation that PO or PO issuance timeline targets Dec 20 (Ben / procurement team).
2) Internal sponsor (Dr. Maya Patel) email confirming the KPI acceptance and go-live window (Jan 15–22).
3) Confirmation that the SOC2/evidence bundle from Monica covers legal needs (Monica — can you confirm you posted the Drive link?).

I’ve opened a DocuSign envelope and set the routing: Novum procurement -> Dr. Patel -> Redwood legal. Link in the related_links field. If Novum can confirm the three items above by EOD Dec 10 we’ll proceed to signature and plan the onboarding week of Jan 4 for validation readiness.

Attachments: 20261206_Joint-Delivery-Plan_v1_redlines.pdf (PDF, 5 pages), launch-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

—Sean

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novumhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Novum Health Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@novumhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated Joint Delivery Plan (v1.1) + redlines incorporated — ready for sign-off

Sean — thanks. Quick status update from our side: 
- Procurement: Ben confirms PO will be issued and in our system by Dec 20. Procurement noted one small billing term tweak which Ben will send as a single-line redline (shouldn't affect dates).
- Sponsor: Dr. Maya Patel has reviewed the KPIs and confirmed verbally; she will send a one-line approval email by EOD tomorrow.
- Security: Monica’s pack covers the SOC2 summary and pen-test abstract; Rishi’s architecture diagram answers the primary network questions.

I just completed the DocuSign envelope (signed by Sarah Liu) and routed to Procurement (Ben) — the envelope shows pending. Once Ben signs and Procurement returns the PO we’re good to go for a Jan 18 go-live (Novum prefer Jan 18 to give the validation team a weekday launch window).

Please treat this as Novum’s sign-off to proceed to signature and deployment planning. We’ll confirm the final PO attachment in the DocuSign envelope when available.

Thanks — excited to move this forward.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Director, Product Integration | Novum Health
Attachments referenced: signed-docusign-envelopes (DocuSign link)
